title: Approval hook: shell quoting in the Bash token scan
lead: *Proposed.* The token scan and the operator comparison read a Bash command the way the shell does for quoting: characters inside single quotes are literal, so a quoted `|`, `;`, `&` or `>` is not an operator. A token that starts with `~` or holds `{` and `,` is judged as the shell would expand it, or asks the owner; it is never passed as a plain relative path.
findings_note: S304 trial 4 (2026-11-15, run ork-20261115-144120-d581, S248): the claude-local implementer's `go -C WT test -run 'TestA|TestB|TestC' -v ./internal/cli` went to the owner as a permission question (owner allowed it). The allowlist rule `Bash(go -C * test*)` did not match because `shellOperators` (`internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:221-229`) counts the `|` inside single quotes. S356 review (deferred): brace expansion (`/a/{b,c}`) and `~` paths are not split or expanded by the token scan (`internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:92-104`), so a path outside the worktree can pass it.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* Go test filters use `|` (`-run 'A|B'`), so every multi-test run by a local role becomes an owner question, about one per test step in trial 4. The `~` and brace cases are the other side of the same parser: they let a path outside the worktree through.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestEvaluateQuotedPipeIsNotAnOperator`: `go -C WT test -run 'TestA|TestB' ./internal/cli` returns allow with reason "role allowlist" under `Bash(go -C * test*)`; also cover quoted semicolon, ampersand and redirection.
- `TestEvaluateUnquotedPipeStillAsks`: unquoted pipe does not match that rule (existing regression guard).
- `TestEvaluateTildePathOutsideWorktree`: `cat ~/.ssh/config` asks or denies under `Bash(cat*)`.
- `TestEvaluateBracePathOutsideWorktree`: `ls /home/{x,y}` stays blocked (existing guard); `ls WT/{safe,escape}/file`, where escape is a symlink outside WT, asks or denies under `Bash(ls*)`.
- `TestEvaluateDoubleQuotedOperator`: double-quoted pipe is literal; double-quoted command substitution and backticks remain blocked (existing guards).
- `TestEvaluateQuotedPathStaysWhole`: a single-quoted absolute path through an outside symlink whose name contains a space is denied.
- `TestEvaluateOutsidePathOverridesAsk`: brace or tilde expansion, incomplete quoting after a comment marker, and a trailing backslash cannot mask an outside absolute path or traversal; each denies with the outside token in the reason.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. A small quote-aware splitter shared by the token scan and `shellOperators`.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
